column2: Habit Tracker Web App: Functional Test Plan v1.0

column3: Habit Tracker is a web app for tracking daily habits and todos. Users complete habits and todos to earn XP, level up, and collect diamonds, which they can spend on accessories and streak freezes. This plan covers the functional testing of the app at https://habit-tracker-snowy-seven.vercel.app/.

1. Verify that every feature works as described in the feature inventory.
2. Find defects in the high-risk areas: date logic, XP/level/diamond chain, and data backup/restore/delete.
3. Verify data persists correctly after refresh, reopen, and restore.
4. Confirm the app is usable on both E1 and E2.
5. Produce a test case sheet, bug log, and coverage summary per feature.

In scope:
- All 37 features across 7 modules, listed under Test Items.
- Functional behavior, data persistence, date-based logic (day change, streak, perfect day), and UI language and appearance switching.
- Environments: E1 Chrome on desktop, E2 web app on iPhone.

Out of scope:
- Performance, load, and security testing.
- Other browsers (Firefox, Edge, Safari desktop), Android, and tablets.
- Email delivery infrastructure behind Sign in (F37), tested only from the user’s side.
- Reminder notifications actually being delivered (F33).
Manual functional testing on E1 and E2. Each action is tested in its normal flow, then with edge inputs. Check that results persist after refresh and reopen.
